rules.threshold_rule: largest T in [0.03,0.10] with mean far<=0.85 and max far<=1.0; junk_full>=30

rule_outcome.note: the pre-registered rule's literal winner; NOT retuned after seeing results

user_decision.why: arm (a) wins the AUC rule but is operationally WORSE than the deployed 13-col model (-1.2pp junk at matched false-AR); b0 is +7.3pp. The rule also contradicted itself (b1-vs-a clears the bar b0-vs-a misses, so the winner depended on comparison order) and its safety metric was computed on the seed-mean OOF, which made it vacuous.
user_decision.b1_rejected: adds +0.0005 AUC on 5/8 seeds over b0 -- nothing; and it would make ring_contrast a permanent dependency on Cn files 40/111 sessions lack

production_followon.change: bootstrap_preagent.py: area-scoped config.BOOTSTRAP_V2B='b0' computes real v2b for bootstrap rows with ring_contrast forced to 0; hiconf from the companion 13-col first-pass model (the same source curator uses), all-False on cold start. BLA/DG_AL never set the key, so they keep assemble_v2_bootstrap unchanged.

sensitivity.question: does the b0 win depend on the hiconf source?
sensitivity.verdict: NO -- within seed noise across the full range from strictly out-of-sample (LSO) to in-sample (deployed)
